info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Data Public Reference Data Management-spec
info.description: The Market Data Public Reference Management API enables users to efficiently manage public reference data related to market data. This API allows for the addition and updating of reference data utilized in financial applications, ensuring that the latest information is consistently available. Typical consumers include financial institutions and data analysts who require accurate market data for decision-making processes. By leveraging this API, businesses can streamline their data management workflows and enhance the integrity of their financial datasets.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new public reference data entry in the market data management system, facilitating better access to essential market reference information.
